finding.detail: v0.3.8 keeps generic specialized receipts from closing VAJRA branches, while distinguishing completion of a bounded counterexample search from certainty about the target claim. A no-counterexample return closes only when it explicitly states bounded scope/coverage and explicitly disclaims proof; the relation channel remains neutral and the resolution is marked BOUNDED_NULL rather than SUPPORTS.
